facts.note: Transcript gives the temple striking ten with the watch at four minutes to ten, and says he sat alone in the dining room with the brandy.
Transcript gives going out to smoke at twenty-one past ten by his watch and staying under the front windows.
Transcript gives the piano starting as he lit his cigar at twenty-nine past ten by his watch, and stopping at eighteen to eleven by his watch.
Transcript gives faint quick bells from the master's window at twenty-six to eleven by his watch, with the piano playing throughout.
Transcript gives returning at fourteen to eleven by his watch, the hall clock just striking eleven with its face at two past, and going up to Félix in the library.
